name: Decision Criticality
definition: A decision table for assessing the criticality of decisions supported by AI systems.

x_org.owasp#aivss:SC:0.1.0.name: Safety-Critical
x_org.owasp#aivss:SC:0.1.0.definition: Degree to which the system meets safety-critical standards and incorporates safety mechanisms.

values.name: Formally Verified
values.definition: System formally verified to meet safety-critical standards (e.g., ISO 26262, IEC 62304).

values.name: Rigorous Testing
values.definition: Rigorous safety testing performed, including edge cases and failure scenarios, with failsafe mechanisms and human oversight.

values.name: Basic Measures
values.definition: Basic safety measures in place, but no rigorous safety testing or formal verification.

values.name: No Consideration
values.definition: System used in safety-critical applications without proper safety considerations or failsafe mechanisms.

x_org.owasp#aivss:FI:0.1.0.name: Financial Impact
x_org.owasp#aivss:FI:0.1.0.definition: Degree to which the system mitigates financial risks and incorporates financial safeguards.

values.name: Minimized Risk
values.definition: System designed to minimize financial risks, with real-time fraud prevention, anomaly detection, and comprehensive insurance coverage.

values.name: Robust Controls
values.definition: Robust financial controls and fraud detection mechanisms in place, regular audits conducted to identify and mitigate financial risks.

values.name: Some Measures
values.definition: Some measures to mitigate financial risks, but no comprehensive risk assessment or fraud prevention mechanisms.

values.name: High Risk
values.definition: High risk of significant financial loss due to system errors or malicious attacks, no safeguards in place.

x_org.owasp#aivss:RD:0.1.0.name: Reputational Damage
x_org.owasp#aivss:RD:0.1.0.definition: Degree to which the system and organization mitigate reputational risks and manage public perception.

values.name: Minimized Risk
values.definition: System designed to minimize reputational risks, with ongoing monitoring, stakeholder engagement, and a crisis management plan.

values.name: Risk Assessment
values.definition: Reputational risk assessment conducted, with communication plans and mitigation strategies in place.

values.name: Awareness
values.definition: Some awareness of reputational risks, limited monitoring of public perception, but no proactive measures.

values.name: High Risk
values.definition: High risk of severe reputational damage due to system errors, biases, or security breaches, no mitigation strategies.

x_org.owasp#aivss:OD:0.1.0.name: Operational Disruption
x_org.owasp#aivss:OD:0.1.0.definition: Degree to which the system is resilient to operational disruption and incorporates business continuity measures.

values.name: High Availability
values.definition: System designed for high availability and resilience, with real-time monitoring, automated recovery, and regular testing of failover mechanisms.

values.name: Robust Controls
values.definition: Robust operational controls, including redundancy, failover mechanisms, and a comprehensive business continuity and disaster recovery plan.

values.name: Some Measures
values.definition: Some measures to mitigate operational risks, but no comprehensive business continuity plan.

values.name: High Risk
values.definition: High risk of significant operational disruption due to system failures or attacks, no backup systems or recovery plans.

x_org.owasp#aivss:DC:0.1.0.name: Decision Criticality
x_org.owasp#aivss:DC:0.1.0.definition: A decision point for assessing the decision criticality of AI models.

values.name: None
values.definition: No known vulnerability or a formally proven resistance to the specific threat.

values.name: Low
values.definition: Low vulnerability with strong mitigation in place, but some minor weaknesses may still exist.

values.name: Medium
values.definition: Moderate vulnerability with some mitigation, but significant weaknesses remain.

values.name: High
values.definition: Severe vulnerability with little to no mitigation in place.
